# Skibla

> Decide sooner. Reach patients faster. Skibla helps medtech and pharma device teams make the decision, with the analysis and the argument behind it.

Diligence, when it counts. Skibla ApS · Birkerød, Denmark · info@skibla.com · +45 50 30 75 73

## Services

- [Services](https://skibla.com/services): Three services, one method: a basis for the decision in medtech and pharma device development.
- [Scoping Projects and Problems](https://skibla.com/scoping): Your ambition turned into three engineered directions with plans, budgets and risk, so you can make the strategic R&D decision.
- [Scoping AI Initiatives](https://skibla.com/ai-scoping): Decide which AI initiatives in R&D are worth running, and what they take in a regulated environment.
- [Injection Device Selection](https://skibla.com/injection-device-selection): Choose your injection device without delaying the drug program. Existing platform or new development, settled before the choice costs you time.

## Cases

- [Illustrative cases](https://skibla.com/cases): Eight illustrative cases from medtech and pharma device development. The numbers and problems are fictional. The method is real.
- [A new dose for a new patient group](https://skibla.com/cases/new-dose-for-a-new-patient-group): A larger dose for a broader patient group, without changing the pen.
- [Passing verification without moving the filing date](https://skibla.com/cases/verification-without-moving-filing): A syringe fracture found six weeks before design verification, and a filing date that could not move.
- [A new delivery route, before the first prototype](https://skibla.com/cases/new-delivery-route-before-first-prototype): How much device is enough for the preclinical studies of a route no device was built for?
- [Five projects, budget for three](https://skibla.com/cases/five-projects-budget-for-three): Five development projects, budget for three, and one yardstick to rank them.
- [Fourteen AI ideas, one development department](https://skibla.com/cases/fourteen-ai-ideas-one-department): Fourteen AI ideas in a device development department, and a QA function that had stopped two pilots.
- [An AI standards advisor for the development team](https://skibla.com/cases/iso-advisor-for-the-development-team): Engineers waited days for answers on standards. An agent that reads the standards and the company's own procedures, and knows when to call QA.
- [Which of our own tools are worth keeping](https://skibla.com/cases/which-tools-are-worth-keeping): Twenty-three home-built tools in one R&D department. Which were worth making professional, and which should go.
- [Platform or new development](https://skibla.com/cases/platform-or-new-development): An existing injection platform or a new device, without making the device the reason the drug program waits.
